title: Support swift-algorand 0.4: AlgoKit(network:) throws, because the configuration factories it calls now throw
description: Support swift-algorand 0.4: AlgoKit(network:) throws, because the configuration factories it calls now throw
acceptance_criteria: AlgoKit builds and its tests pass against swift-algorand 0.4.0 and against 0.3.x; AlgoKit(network:) is throwing and propagates the configuration factory's error; AlgoKit(configuration:) is unchanged; the README examples use try.
